about.title: About & report
about.disclaimer: Fares are based on LTFRB fare guides effective September 28, 2026. They are for reference only. Actual fares may vary by route, LGU ordinance or operator. For complaints or clarification, call the LTFRB 24/7 Hotline 1342 or visit www.ltfrb.gov.ph. This app is not affiliated with LTFRB.
about.rule1: Fares are rounded to the nearest ₱0.25 for jeepney, UV Express and bus.
about.rule2: Partial kilometres are rounded up to the next whole kilometre.
about.rule3: The Student / Senior / PWD discount applies every day, including weekends and holidays (MC 2017-024).
about.rule4: Taxi and TNVS totals are shown to the centavo; the meter may round differently.
about.offline: Works offline after the first visit.
about.routesCredit: Route planner: NCR jeepney and UV Express routes from the LTFRB route shapefile (routes per LTFRB memorandum circulars). Rail and Busway stations from DOTr / LTFRB fare matrices.

plan.title: Route planner
plan.homeSub: Jeep, UV, train and Busway routes in Metro Manila, with the fare of every ride
plan.hintDone: Tap an option to see it on the map.
plan.dataError: Couldn't load the route data. Check your connection and try again.
plan.error: Something went wrong while planning. Try again.
plan.none: No route found in the available route data within a short walk. Try a nearby landmark or a main road, or change the modes.
plan.note: Routes: LTFRB NCR jeepney and UV Express route data ({{n}} routes, per LTFRB memorandum circulars), plus LRT-1, LRT-2, MRT-3 and the EDSA Busway. The return direction is assumed to use the same roads (not verified). Times are estimates: ride time at average speeds plus walking, a fixed wait for each ride and a transfer allowance; no live traffic or schedules. Fares are official LTFRB/DOTr fares for each ride. Not affiliated with LTFRB.
plan.walkToStop: Walk {{m}} m (about {{min}} min) to the stop near {{place}}
plan.landmarkNote: Landmarks and street names are from OpenStreetMap and may be approximate.

plan.dragHint: Drag A or B to move them.
plan.searchFailed: Place search is not available right now. Your text is kept. Try again, or pick a station or a saved place.
plan.searchOffline: You are offline, so place search is unavailable. Stations and saved places still work.
plan.coverage: This uses LTFRB-authorised NCR jeep and UV routes plus the rail lines and EDSA Busway. A route that is not in this data may still exist.
plan.assumptions: Route lines are authorised LTFRB routes, not proof a vehicle runs there now. The return direction is assumed to use the same roads, and get-on, get-off and transfer points are approximate. Check with the driver or barker.
plan.timeIncludes: Estimate: ride time at average speeds, walking, a fixed wait per ride and a transfer allowance. No live traffic.

limit.distance: The fare rule is from the published LTFRB guide, but the fare is only as exact as the distance used. Partial kilometres are rounded up.
